section.3: The Book Of The Prayer For Rain (Kitab al-Istisqa')

3.name_native: The Book Of The Prayer For Rain (Kitab al-Istisqa')

hadiths.text: Narrated A'ishah (May Allah be pleased with her):The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon on him) recited from teh Qur'an in a loud voice in the prayer at an eclipse
